    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in body), max(r for r, c in body)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in body), max(c for r, c in body)
    kr0, kr1 = min(r for r, c in key), max(r for r, c in key)
    kc0, kc1 = min(c for r, c in key), max(c for r, c in key)
    n = kr1 - kr0 + 1
    scale = (r1 - r0 + 1) // n
    # Rotate the compact color key 90 degrees clockwise.
    rotated = [[grid[kr1 - c][kc0 + r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in body:
        out[r][c] = rotated[(r - r0) // scale][(c - c0) // scale]
    return out
"
